int.MinValue : nums1[partitionX - 1];\n            int minX = (partitionX == x) ? int.MaxValue : nums1[partitionX];\n            int maxY = (partitionY == 0) ? int.MinValue : nums2[partitionY - 1];\n            int minY = (partitionY == y) ? int.MaxValue : nums2[partitionY];\n\n            // Check if we have found the correct partition\n            if (maxX <= minY && maxY <= minX)\n            {\n                // We have found the correct partition, calculate the median\n                if ((x + y) % 2 == 0)\n                {\n                    return (double)(Math.Max(maxX, maxY) + Math.Min(minX, minY)) / 2.0;\n                }\n                else\n                {\n                    return Math.Max(maxX, maxY);\n                }\n            }\n            else if (maxX > minY)\n            {\n                // Move partitionX to the left\n                high = partitionX - 1;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                // Move partitionX to the right\n                low = partitionX + 1;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // This should not happen for valid inputs\n        throw new ArgumentException(\"Input arrays are not sorted.\");\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"median-of-two-sorted-arrays","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":270}
